Hi Olga / Marissa,

Apologies for the short notice — our CTO was just pulled into a customer on-site that will run through Friday morning. We currently have the Redwood walkthrough scheduled for Friday 10:00 AM PT. Given the exec travel and a couple of overlapping leadership syncs, is there any chance we can shift?

Options that would work for us:

- Monday 9:00 AM PT

If neither works, we can collapse the agenda to a 30-minute condensed demo this week. Appreciate any flexibility — we’re excited to evaluate Redwood but travel is tricky this week.

Plan (fallback + coverage):
- Option A: Move to Friday 2:00 PM PT and run the full walkthrough as planned. Ben can lead the demo (SE coverage) and I’ll handle the account-level context.
- Option B: Keep Friday 10:00 AM PT but condense to a focused 30-minute demo (high-level product + 10-minute integration Q&A). See attached condensed agenda.
- Option C: Move to Monday 9:00 AM PT for full walkthrough; Marissa noted she’s traveling Friday and may not be available, so we’ll confirm SE assignment if you pick Monday.

Attachments: condensed_agenda_30m.pdf (short run-of-show)

Can you confirm which option you prefer and whether the CTO must attend? If you pick Option A or C and need a deep-dive on infra, Marissa or Dev can join for the technical Q&A — they’re looped here.

Next steps I’ll take once you confirm:
- Lock calendar and send Zoom link
- Share run-of-show and relevant docs (MMP + integration checklist)

Thanks — Olga
